title: Generation of glutamatergic/GABAergic neuronal co-cultures derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells for characterizing E/I balance in vitro
protocol: Dilute poly-L-ornithine in filtered borate buffer (50 mM) to a final concentration of 50 μg/mL.
Pretreat coverslips in nitric acid overnight.
Wash coverslips extensively with Milli-Q water for 20 times, immersing them and gently shaking the beaker each time for at least 1 minute.
Distribute washed coverslips evenly in a petri dish without overlapping before autoclaving.
Use prepared coverslips as needed.
Sterilize Polyethersulfone filter with pore size of 0.22 μm.
Incubate samples at 37°C and 5% CO2 for at least 3 hours.
Thaw laminin-521 slowly at 4°C.
Aspirate diluted poly-L-ornithine from the wells.
Wash each well with 500 µL of filtered Milli-Q water three times.
Dilute laminin-521 (100 μg/mL) 20 times in DPBSCa2+/Mg2+ to achieve a final concentration of 5 μg/mL.
Add diluted laminin-521 as per the required volume for the culturing format.
Incubate at 4°C overnight.
Dissociate hiPSC colonies into single cells for plating.
Plate rtTA/Ngn2- and rtTA/Ascl1-positive hiPSC lines for direct conversion to neurons.
Maintain glutamatergic neuron density while altering GABAergic neuron numbers for different E/I plating ratios.
Calculate the volume of medium required for each well or plate.
Warm up the plating medium according to the table and bring it to room temperature.
Prewarm 10 mL of DMEM/F-12 to room temperature.
Prewarm 1 mL of Accutase to room temperature.
Check the confluency of rtTA/Ascl1-positive hiPSCs under a microscope.
Remove medium from the well completely.
Rinse the well once with 2 mL DPBS and aspirate.
Add 1 mL of Accutase to the rtTA/Ascl1-positive hiPSC line.
Incubate at 37°C for 3-5 minutes.
Check under the microscope whether the cells are detaching.
Add 2 mL DMEM/F-12 and gently suspend the cells using a pipette, then transfer the cell suspension to a falcon tube.
Add 8 mL DMEM/F-12 to the cell suspension in the falcon tube.
Spin at 200 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 2 mL of hiPSC plating medium.
Resuspend the hiPSCs into single cells by putting the tip of a pipette against the side of the falcon tube and resuspending the cells gently.
Check under the microscope whether the cells are single cells; if not, continue resuspending the cells.
Take a sample for counting after ensuring cells are in single-cell suspension.
Count the cells using a counting chamber.
Aspirate the diluted laminin from the precoated plate and add 500 μL of E8 Flex medium per well in a 24-well plate, and 150 μL per MEA well.
Plate the dissociated cells in prepared plates at a density of 8000 cells per well.
Incubate rtTA/Ascl1-positive cells for 1–2 hours to allow attachment at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Wash cultures twice with 500 μL DMEM/F-12 after virus incubation if separating neuronal cell types is needed.
Plate 18,000 rtTA/Ngn2-positive hiPSCs per well after the rtTA/Ascl1-positive cells have attached.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 1 hour after adding the cells to the MEA plate.
Refill each well with fresh medium to reach a volume of 500 μL.
Refresh medium on culture maintenance Day 1 to induce proper differentiation.
Calculate the volume of medium required: 500 μL per well.
Compose Neuronal differentiation medium_1 according to the specified table.
Prewarm the medium to 37°C.
Filter the resulting medium and add mouse laminin to a final concentration of 0.2 μg/mL.
Aspirate the medium from the wells gently.
Add 500 μL of the prepared medium per well.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Prewarm 0.05% trypsin-EDTA to room temperature.
Prewarm DMEM/F-12 medium and DPBS (without Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺) to 37°C.
Aspirate the medium of the astrocytes.
Add 5 mL of DPBS (without Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺) to a T75 culture flask.
Rock the flask gently after adding DPBS without Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺.
Aspirate the DPBS from the flask.
Add 5 mL of 0.05% trypsin-EDTA to the flask and rock gently.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO₂ for 5–10 minutes.
Check under the microscope whether cells are detaching.
Tap the flask a few times if some cells remain attached.
Add 5 mL of astrocyte medium to the flask.
Triturate cells gently inside the flask with a 10 mL pipette.
Collect 10 mL cell suspension in a 15 mL falcon tube.
Spin the tube at 200 × g for 8 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant from the falcon tube.
Resuspend the cells in 1–3 mL of DMEM/F-12.
Triturate repeatedly with a 1,000 μL pipette 10–15 times against the side of the tube to get a single cell suspension.
Count the cells using a counting chamber.
Add 26,000 astrocytes per well in a 1:1 ratio compared to hiPSCs present.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO₂.
Aspirate 350 μl culturing medium from each well on the MEA plate.
Add astrocytes to ensure they attach to the bottom of the wells.
Incubate the plates at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 1 hour.
Refill each well with fresh medium to reach a total volume of 500 μl per well.
Calculate the volume of medium required: 500 μL per well on day 3.
Compose "Neuronal differentiation medium_2" according to provided instructions.
Prewarm the medium to 37°C before use.
Aspirate the existing medium from the wells gently.
Add 500 μl of prepared medium per well.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Calculate the volume of medium required: 250 μL per well.
Prewarm the medium to 37°C.
Aspirate 230 μL of the medium from each well.
Add 250 μL of the prepared medium per well.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Calculate the volume of medium required: 250 μL per well.
Prewarm the medium to 37°C.
Aspirate 230 μL of the medium from each well.
Add 250 μL of the prepared medium per well supplemented with FBS.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Prewarm the medium to 37°C.
Aspirate 230 μL of the medium from each well.
Add 250 μL of the prepared medium per well.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Calculate the volume of medium required: 250 μL per number of 24-well plate well or MEA well.
Compose the “Neuronal differentiation medium_5” according to the table in the materials and equipment section.
Fix the cells seeded on coverslips with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) supplemented with 4% sucrose in PBS for 15 min at room temperature.
Mix 500 μL of second antibody dilution and Hoechst 33342 dilution per well to cover the coverslips.
Aspirate PFA and wash the cells at least three times with PBS.
Add 0.2% Triton diluted in PBS for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate Triton and add 5% normal goat serum diluted in PBS for 1 hour at room temperature.
Incubate the cells overnight at 4°C with 80 μL primary antibody dilution (dilutions shown in the key resources table).
Remove the primary antibody dilution and wash the cells at least three times with PBS.
Incubate the cells for 1 hour at room temperature with secondary antibodies (dilutions shown in the key resources table).
Remove the secondary antibody and wash the cells at least three times with PBS.
Add Hoechst 33342 diluted 1:10000 in PBS for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate Hoechst 33342 dilution.
Wash cells three times with PBS.
Add a single drop (5 μL) of fluorescent mounting medium to the center of a slide.
Place the coverslip on top of the mounting media using a tweezer.
Store mounted slides at 4°C for short term or -20°C for long term storage.
Analyze fluorescent images using FIJI software.
Count synapse puncta manually and normalize to the length of the dendritic branch.
Take the MEA plate out of the incubator.
Place the MEA plate in the recording chamber maintained at 37°C and 5% CO2 level.
Mix carbogen gas at a ratio of 5% CO2 and 95% O2.
Allow cultures on MEA to adapt for 10 minutes in the recording chamber before recording.
Record 10 minutes of electrophysiological activity from neurons cultured on MEAs.
